system.description: Starting at 17th level, when you use the Superior Momentum class feature, you can gain 2 Actions, instead of one. But you also increase the superiority die cost by +2. These extra Actions still cannot be used to cast a jutsu of the same casting discipline you previously cast on this turn.

source.custom: Imported full source rules; contextual benefits require adjudication.

rules.text: Superior Momentum can give 2 actions for 2 more dice (still not the same discipline as one you cast this turn).
